slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Must the demand at each demand point j be satisfied exactly (total received equals b_j), or is it acceptable to receive less than b_j (i.e., demand is a minimum that must be met at least, with any excess allowed)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether demand must be satisfied exactly or can be less, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost, defined as the sum of all unit transportation costs (production-to-station plus station-to-demand) plus the fixed costs of the stations that are opened?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and included both transportation and fixed station costs.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0/P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots, including exact demand satisfaction and total-cost minimization, and stopped appropriately after confirming key modeling assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
